CVE-2026-102956.title: Ethernet L2 net_pkt reference-count error on ARP request send failure can free an unrelated packet
CVE-2026-102956.description:
ethernet_send() in subsys/net/l2/ethernet/ethernet.c dropped the caller's reference on an IPv4 packet whenever net_arp_prepare() returned NET_ARP_PKT_REPLACED. That return value is also used when ARP could not queue the packet because every ARP cache entry is already pending. In that case ARP holds no reference of its own, so the original packet was freed before the replacing ARP request was transmitted.

If transmitting the ARP request then failed (a driver send error or an ethernet_fill_header() failure), the error path called net_pkt_ref() on the freed packet. net_if_tx() then called net_pkt_unref() on it again. If the freed net_pkt slab slot was reallocated in between, the stray unref releases a reference owned by an unrelated packet, which is freed while still in use.

An attacker on the local link can drive the ARP cache into the all-pending state. CONFIG_NET_ARP_TABLE_SIZE defaults to 2, so it is enough to elicit replies to a few spoofed, non-responding on-subnet addresses.…

CVE-2026-115538.title: Docker Engine overlay-network encryption rules are not restored after a firewalld reload
CVE-2026-115538.description: Moby's overlay network driver does not restore the iptables rules for encrypted overlay networks after firewalld deletes them. Unlike other Docker Engine networking components, the overlay driver does not handle firewalld reload or start signals over D-Bus. The missing rules cause outgoing VXLAN datagrams to bypass IPsec encryption and remove the protection against incoming cleartext VXLAN traffic. The condition is not logged by dockerd and persists until the encrypted network's last local endpoint is removed and another is added, or dockerd is restarted. Each further firewalld event repeats the condition.

CVE-2026-118670.description: OHIF Viewers is a zero-footprint DICOM viewer with shared extension packages. The malicious DICOM object may be opened locally, uploaded to a shared PACS, or supplied by a DICOMweb source. This issue is fixed in source versions 3.12.15, 3.13.7, and 3.14.0-beta.19.

ocfs2/heartbeat: unlink live slots when their node is missing

configfs registry. A slot can still be linked in o2hb_live_slots when

a predecessor into the freed array. Reusing the node number can also make

callback: the existing callback interface explicitly permits a NULL node
for DOWN events. Only drop the node reference when lookup returned one.

CVE-2026-99643.title: khugepaged: fix readahead lock inversion in collapse_file()
CVE-2026-99643.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

khugepaged: fix readahead lock inversion in collapse_file()

collapse_file() can call page_cache_sync_readahead() while still holding
source folios locked. If truncate holds mapping->invalidate_lock
exclusively and waits for one of those folios, readahead waits for
invalidate_lock and neither side can make progress.

We need to release those folio locks before starting readahead. On a page
cache miss, roll back first, populate the collapse range, and retry once.
Doing readahead after rollback avoids an extra pass when all folios are
already present. If another miss occurs on retry, give up rather than keep
retrying while truncate or reclaim removes folios.

Keep page_cache_sync_readahead() and wait for read I/O with
filemap_lock_folio(), releasing each folio before moving to the next. The
existing uptodate check during collapse still handles read errors.
